LanguageData.LP_Sub_Titan.label: Titan Fighter
LanguageData.LP_Sub_Titan.description: A warrior carrying ancient giant blood: the higher the level, the bigger the body (body size ×(1 + 2.5% × fighter level), ×1.5 at level 20, continuing to grow with legend levels up to ×2.0; the graphics grow too), with an extra +3% part health per level. Bullies smaller foes in melee, stomps to knock down crowds, and finally can briefly become a titan.
